content: {"reasoning":"The payer denied CPT 93271 as bundled and not separately payable, and both available review paths—peer-to-peer and formal appeal—have already been attempted without success. Resubmission would not correct the bundling determination, and the deductible does not make the patient liable for a contractually nonpayable service; with no secondary payer, no collectible balance remains.","action":"write_off"}
